---
description: "Use when changing the caching components: file_cache, block_cache, attr_cache, entry_cache, xload or distributed_cache. Covers per-path locks, cache eviction, upload on flush, xload path confinement, the distributed cache, and concurrency tests."
applyTo: "component/file_cache/**,component/block_cache/**,component/attr_cache/**,component/entry_cache/**,component/xload/**,component/distributed_cache/**"
---
# Caching components

- `file_cache` (caching mode) downloads whole files to local disk and uploads them on flush, sync or release. `block_cache` (streaming mode) reads and writes fixed-size blocks with prefetching. `xload` preloads files into the local cache. These three are mutually exclusive in a pipeline. `attr_cache` and `entry_cache` cache metadata and directory listings.
- `distributed_cache` is a second-level cache below `block_cache` for read-only mounts; `cmd/mount.go` inserts the `block_cache` above it. Both must use the same block size, which comes from `block_cache.block-size-mb`. Its unit tests run against a fake cache server in the test process (`distributed_cache_integration_test.go`).
- Operations on the same path are serialized with per-path locks from `common.LockMap`: `flock := fc.fileLocks.Get(name); flock.Lock(); defer flock.Unlock()`. State of an open file is guarded by `handle.Lock()`. Read the existing callers before you change lock scope.
- The cache cleanup and eviction workers (`lru_policy.go` in `file_cache`) must not block file operations: a busy file is retried later instead of waiting for its lock. Queuing cleanup work must not block either. Breaking this caused hangs under concurrent closes and renames (PR #2383).
- A change to when or what `file_cache` uploads must keep these cases correct, each fixed recently: writes served natively by libfuse (see the libfuse instructions), a flush while the application is still writing (PR #2388), and a release of a renamed file whose name was reused (PR #2383).
- `xload` does all local file I/O through one `*os.Root` (`xl.root`, opened by `createDownloader` during `Start`), so names can't resolve outside the xload path. Use the root's methods (`OpenFile`, `MkdirAll`, `Remove`, `Chtimes`, ...) instead of `os` functions on joined paths, and pass every name from a remote listing through `localName()` in `utils.go`, which rejects absolute, `..` and non-canonical names (PR #2480).
- Tests build a small pipeline with `loopbackfs` as the next component, for example `newTestFileCache(newLoopbackFS())` in `file_cache_test.go` and `setupPipeline` in `block_cache_test.go`, from a config string. Use `t.TempDir()` for the cache and storage paths.
- For a change to locking, goroutines or eviction, add a concurrent regression test and run it with `make test-race PKG=./component/file_cache TEST_FLAGS='-run TestFileCacheTestSuite/<Test> -count=20'`. Then run `make test-loopback`, which mounts `libfuse → file_cache → loopbackfs` and runs a concurrent close, fsync and rename workload.
